name: Venomancer: Fangbinder and Potent Expulsion modify Serpent's Fang healing and Expulsion's damage over time (#1995, #1999)
contract: #1995 and #1999 report 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' for two class passives that are native spell modifiers (SpellFamilyName 35). #1995: Fangbinder (560195) effect 0 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_DAMAGE BasePoints 49 (+50%), class mask (0x400000,0,0) = Serpent's Fang heal 560202 (SpellFamilyFlags 0x400000; SpellHealingBonusDone applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE to healing, Unit.cpp); effect 1 is aura 107 SPELLMOD_RESIST_MISS_CHANCE BasePoints 99 (+100), class mask (0,0x1000000,0) = Serpent's Fang 800946 (flags 0,0x1000000,0), which Unit::MagicSpellHitResult adds to the base hit chance before clamping to 100%, so the spell can no longer miss. #1999: Potent Expulsion (560266) is aura 108 SPELLMOD_DOT BasePoints 19 (+20%), class mask (0,0,0x4) = Expulsion 805094 (flags 0,0,0x4, periodic damage aura 3), applied by SpellDamageBonusDone for periodic damage. The scenario compares one Venomancer before and after learning each passive: healing done of 560202 with a fixed base of 1000, periodic and direct damage done of 805094 with a fixed base of 1000, and the native modifier values, and it asserts that each passive leaves the other's spell untouched. The no-miss clause is asserted through its native modifier (hit chance 83 becomes 183, clamped to 100% in MagicSpellHitResult); the miss roll itself is random and is not sampled.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Serpent's Fang healing done before any passive
Serpent's Fang healing has a positive baseline
Expulsion periodic damage done before any passive
Expulsion periodic damage has a positive baseline
Expulsion direct-path damage done before any passive
No damage modifier on Serpent's Fang healing before learning
No resist/miss modifier on Serpent's Fang before learning
No DoT modifier on Expulsion before learning
Learn Fangbinder
Fangbinder is +50% on Serpent's Fang healing (560202)
Serpent's Fang healing done is 1.5x its baseline
Fangbinder adds a flat +100 to Serpent's Fang's hit chance (83 -> 183, clamped to 100%)
Fangbinder's hit-chance clause does not reach Venomtip Poison
Fangbinder's damage clause does not touch Serpent's Fang's own damage
Fangbinder leaves Expulsion's periodic damage alone
Learn Potent Expulsion
Potent Expulsion is +20% DoT on Expulsion (805094)
Expulsion periodic damage done is 1.2x its baseline
Potent Expulsion does not raise Expulsion's direct-path damage
Potent Expulsion does not touch Serpent's Fang healing modifiers
Fangbinder's healing bonus is still 1.5x after Potent Expulsion
